title: Unified health-data record (aifitnessapi.com, v1)
description: A vendor-neutral shape for 9 common health records, each field mapped to HealthKit, Health Connect, the Google Health API and Wear OS Health Services at https://aifitnessapi.com/schema. Version 1.0.0. License: CC BY 4.0 (attribution: aifitnessapi.com).

nativeType.description: The source's own type name (an HK identifier, a Health Connect class, a Google Health API data type).

sourceName.description: The app or device that wrote it, when the source says.

HeartRate.title: Heart rate sample
HeartRate.description: One heart-rate reading at one instant, in beats per minute.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.

Steps.title: Step count over an interval
Steps.description: The number of steps taken between two instants.

startTime.description: Start of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

endTime.description: End of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

startUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the start as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

endUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the end as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

SleepSession.title: Sleep session with stages
SleepSession.description: One sleep period and the stages inside it, each stage an interval with one value from the unified stage vocabulary.

startTime.description: Start of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

endTime.description: End of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

startUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the start as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

endUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the end as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

stages.description: Non-overlapping stage intervals inside the session; empty when the source has none.

Workout.title: Workout session
Workout.description: One exercise session: when it ran, what it was, and the totals where the source states them.

startTime.description: Start of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

endTime.description: End of the interval, RFC 3339 in UTC.

startUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the start as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

endUtcOffset.description: UTC offset at the end as ±HH:MM; null when unknown.

activityType.description: The activity as this site's workout crosswalk key (Two constants share a crosswalk row only when their names are identical after removing a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ (Health Connect's prefix, which the Google Health API also uses on EXERCISE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED), lowercasing, and removing every character that is not a letter or a digit). null when the source value is not in the crosswalk data.

nativeActivityType.description: The source's own activity value, unchanged (an Objective-C constant, an Int as text, or an enum string).

energyKcal.description: Total energy for the session in kilocalories; null when the source carries none.

distanceMeters.description: Total distance in meters; null when the source carries none.

BodyMass.title: Body mass (weight)
BodyMass.description: The user's weight at one instant, in kilograms.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.

BodyFat.title: Body fat percentage
BodyFat.description: Body fat as a percentage from 0 to 100.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.

Height.title: Height
Height.description: The user's height at one instant, in meters.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.

HeartRateVariability.title: Heart rate variability
HeartRateVariability.description: One HRV reading in milliseconds, tagged with the statistic it is. SDNN and RMSSD are different measures and never convert into each other.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.

metric.description: sdnn: standard deviation of heartbeat intervals. rmssd: root mean square of successive differences.

OxygenSaturation.title: Blood oxygen saturation (SpO2)
OxygenSaturation.description: One SpO2 reading as a percentage from 0 to 100.

time.description: The instant of the reading, RFC 3339 in UTC (a trailing Z).

utcOffset.description: The user's UTC offset at that instant as ±HH:MM; null when the source does not carry one.
